allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,Path })
